query:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_price), 0)
            FROM   orders
            WHERE  farm_id    = $1
              AND  is_deleted = FALSE
              AND  status     = 'DELIVERED'
              AND  ($2 = '' OR created_at::date >= $2::date)
              AND  ($3 = '' OR created_at::date <= $3::date)
